LESSON: CURVED MIRRORS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Force and Energy
Topic 3.1: Curved mirrors

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Curved mirrors
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are curved mirrors used in day-to-day life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe types of curved mirrors
2. draw ray diagrams to locate images formed by concave and convex mirrors
3. describe the characteristics of images formed by concave and convex mirrors
4. explain the uses of concave and convex mirrors in day-to-day life
5. appreciate the applications of curved mirrors in
6. describe the generation of waves in nature
7. classify waves as longitudinal and transverse
8. describe basic characteristics of waves in nature

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Curved mirrors

Teach
• Observe Curved mirrors in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Curved mirrors (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Curved mirrors.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Curved mirrors.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Curved mirrors.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe types of curved mirrors
• draw ray diagrams to locate images formed by concave and convex mirrors
• describe the characteristics of images formed by concave and convex mirrors

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Curved mirrors.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Curved mirrors: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are curved mirrors used in day-to-day life?
2. How are waves applied in our day-to- day life?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe types of curved mirrors
• draw ray diagrams to locate images formed by concave and convex mirrors
• describe the characteristics of images formed by concave and convex mirrors
• explain the uses of concave and convex mirrors in day-to-day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
